scope: Local province/city/county card preview, replacing 3D camera navigation
boundaries: See research/admin-map-audit.json and map-data/manifest.json. Local gzip snapshots; no runtime third-party map requests.
destinationPhotos: Only existing real, sourced images from the exact province/city/district scope. Captions identify the city and attraction. Representative city lists are editorial entry suggestions.
limitations: Historical boundary snapshots, not a verified 2026 administrative census. Uniform 3D extrusion is decorative, not terrain.
runtime: destination-cards.js and destination-cards.css; no Three.js or compressed boundaries loaded
